title: CardCraft
description: A collectible card system where mobs drop cards — collect, album, and trade with players!
body:
CardCraft — Collect them all!

CardCraft adds a complete collectible card system to your Paper server. Defeat Minecraft mobs, collect their unique cards, complete your persistent album, and trade duplicates with other players through a clean and safe GUI.

Every mob can drop its own card, with rarities ranging from Common to Legendary. Your collection is saved permanently, so your progress is never lost even after server restarts.

Features

100+ collectible cards — cards for Minecraft mobs, including rare, epic, and legendary variants.
Persistent album — every collected card is saved in a SQLite database and stays saved across restarts.
Automatic inventory sync — if a player has a card in their inventory, it is automatically added to their album.
Player trading — trade cards safely with other players using a simple GUI.
Cards-only trade system — the trade GUI only accepts CardCraft cards, preventing item abuse and confusion.
Mob drop system — mobs naturally drop cards when defeated.
Configurable drop chances — adjust rarity chances and weapon enchantment bonuses in the config.
Enchanted weapon bonus — Sharpness and Looting can increase card drop chances.
Passive card effects — some rare, epic, and legendary cards grant passive effects while carried.
Bilingual support — full English and Portuguese language support.
Commands

Command	Description
/album	Open your card collection
/trade <player>	Invite another player to trade cards
/card give <player> <id>	Give a card to a player (admin)
/cardcraft setlang <en|pt>	Change the server language (admin)
/cardcraft reload	Reload config and language files (admin)
Requirements

Paper 1.21.x
Java 21
Short version

CardCraft is a collectible card plugin for Paper servers. Defeat mobs, collect cards, complete your album, trade duplicates, and hunt rare legendary variants. Perfect for survival, SMP, and collection-based servers.
